summary: monitor odometry, wheel encoder pose, robot speed, heading, x y position, velocity, travelled distance
description: Streams mobile robot odometry. Output lines include pose, heading, linear velocity, angular velocity, or travelled distance, for example 'odom x=2.14 y=0.35 yaw=45deg v=0.20m/s w=0.05rad/s'. Runs continuously until killed by the boss.
